All 276 cases form eight complete symmetry orbits and all contain a full vertex star. Each checker was replayed from its packaged source.

value.rationale: Complete optimal-failure census for the distinguished planar bondage counterexample: 276 five-edge cuts across 8 automorphism orbits; all isolate vertices (240 isolate one, 36 isolate two).
